releaseNotes: File Type multi-select is cleaner: Share and single-file Rename stay with the selected count, while Add to Category and Delete appear below the Smart Summary/Uncategorized area with full-width buttons so Delete no longer wraps. In Photos, selecting exactly one photo adds Rename inside the three-dot More menu. Photo rename updates the real Android MediaStore/file so Gallery sees the new name. Albums/Folders remain real Android folders: Create Album/Folder and Move continue to change the actual phone gallery structure.
